operators.name: ReconstructVerify
operators.subtitle: Keep byte identity, address reconstruction and cell verification separate.
outputs: Separate checked-level flags and original facts
Native citation, typed outcomes and diagnostics
operators.relation_title: Selected canonical fields; supported stdlib OOXML cases
notes: $\widehat E_S$: reconstructed selected evidence; F: row, column, value, kind, formula, merge, hidden.
Levels: byte identity / address reconstruction / stored observations; interpretation unsupported.
unavailable · corrupt · mismatch · invalid_input; formula text and stored cache stay distinct.
operators.limit: Selected-cell checks do not establish formula results, Excel display or workbook completeness.

operators.name: AccountLoss
operators.subtitle: Observe recorded declarations without mutating the extraction run.
inputs: Units, cell losses, declared risks and capabilities
operators.relation_title: Deduplicated declarations and qualified contract success
notes: $T_{\mathrm{after}}=T_{\mathrm{before}}$; repeated unit / kind declarations are counted once.
Unsupported capabilities and unsurfaced risks prevent a justified complete-success claim.
$\mathrm{coverage}_{\mathrm{workbook}}=\mathrm{unknown}$, even when no losses are recorded.
operators.limit: Counts describe unit loss declarations; they do not prove independent source-loss events.
